title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
method: 给出含中间推导的少量示例，让模型生成推导再回答。
reported_effect: 540B模型仅8个CoT示例即在GSM8K达到当时最强水平；还测算术、常识和符号任务。
mechanism_interpretation: 把一次直接映射变成多次可条件化计算，推导成为外部工作区。
conditions_and_limits: 基础CoT并非今天万token长链；效果依赖模型规模、示例和任务，不能直接解释现代RL长链。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
venue_description: Published at ICLR 2023. V2: added PaLM results; V3: added UL2 results; V4: camera ready version at ICLR 2023
method: 采样多条不同推理路径，边缘化路径后按答案聚合。
reported_effect: 作者摘要报告GSM8K +17.9、SVAMP +11.0、AQuA +12.2个百分点等增益。
mechanism_interpretation: 用多路径降低单次贪心路径的偶然错误，关键是有效多样性。
conditions_and_limits: 并行采样不是单链变长；答案众数可一致地错，增加路径有实际成本。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
venue_description: NeurIPS 2023 camera ready version. Code repo with all prompts: [linked resource on primary page]
method: 以thought为节点，用评估和搜索实现前瞻、回退与多路线选择。
reported_effect: GPT-4在Game of 24由CoT的4%提高至74%。
mechanism_interpretation: 把不可撤销的逐token承诺变成可比较、可回退的状态搜索。
conditions_and_limits: 提升来自特定规划任务和多次模型调用；74%不能外推到一般数学或同算力单链。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally can be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters
method: 按题目难度分配搜索验证与自我修订计算。
reported_effect: 相对best-of-N，作者报告计算效率超过4倍；在特定FLOPs匹配条件下可超过14倍大的模型。
mechanism_interpretation: 不同难度需要不同搜索深度/宽度，均匀撒算力浪费预算。
conditions_and_limits: 是FLOPs与成功率条件下的结果，不等于固定GPU墙钟快4倍；弱模型须有非零解题机会。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Selected original methods/results or component controls inspected; not a universal causal proof

method: 筛出1000条难度、覆盖和质量兼顾的轨迹SFT，再用budget forcing改变思考长度。

mechanism_interpretation: 少量高质量轨迹激活行为模板，追加Wait使已有策略继续探索。
conditions_and_limits: 时间短不代表训练算力低；不同选样消融差异大，Wait不是通用正确性操作。

title: Let's Verify Step by Step
alias: PRM / Let’s Verify Step by Step
method: 用每步人工反馈训练过程奖励模型，比较过程监督与终局监督。
reported_effect: 代表性MATH测试子集解出78%；发布80万步级标签PRM800K。
mechanism_interpretation: 把终局稀疏对错分解为可定位的中间质量反馈。
conditions_and_limits: 78%不是不带搜索的裸模型pass@1；依赖标注、采样和验证器，推理成本需另计。

title: Training Language Models to Self-Correct via Reinforcement Learning
method: 在模型自己生成的两轮轨迹上做分阶段在线RL，先解耦两次作答，再奖励纠错进展。
reported_effect: Gemini系列上作者报告MATH自纠错改善15.6、HumanEval改善9.1个百分点。
mechanism_interpretation: 同时处理离线纠错数据的分布偏移和不愿修改答案的行为塌缩；普通多轮RL也会塌缩。
conditions_and_limits: 需要专门训练及可验证奖励；两轮计算和单轮结果不应混比。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Selected original methods/results or component controls inspected; not a universal causal proof

title: Satori: Reinforcement Learning with Chain-of-Action-Thought Enhances LLM Reasoning via Autoregressive Search
venue_description: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 267:54663-54700, 2025.
method: 用继续、反思和探索等meta-action组织思维链；格式热身后结合Restart-and-Explore与RL。
reported_effect: 消融中RAE使MATH500由81.6到85.6、AMC2023由57.5到67.5；AIME24两者均20.0。
mechanism_interpretation: 让训练见到正确和错误中间状态，奖励从错到对、惩罚从对到错，训练真实修订行为。
conditions_and_limits: 并非所有任务每个模块都提升；反思标记不证明有效反思，需按动作和收益验证。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Selected original methods/results or component controls inspected; not a universal causal proof

title: rStar-Math: Small LLMs Can Master Math Reasoning with Self-Evolved Deep Thinking
method: 用代码增强MCTS轨迹、过程偏好模型及多轮自演化训练小模型。
reported_effect: Qwen2.5-Math-7B在MATH由58.8%到90.0%；AIME平均53.3%。
mechanism_interpretation: 搜索把稀有成功轨迹变成训练数据，策略与评估模型互相提高。
conditions_and_limits: 使用74.7万题、百万级轨迹和4轮演化；小参数模型不等于低总成本。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: L1: Controlling How Long A Reasoning Model Thinks With Reinforcement Learning
method: 把目标长度作为条件，RL同时优化答对与长度遵循，并区分Exact和Max约束。
reported_effect: 1.5B L1在相同短链长度下超过GPT-4o；长度可在512/1024/2048/3600等点控制。
mechanism_interpretation: 把长度控制内化为策略，不只是临时切断输出。
conditions_and_limits: Exact可能鼓励凑长度；Max约束更接近有限预算。训练4k上下文、评估8k，不能默认覆盖任意长链。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Selected original methods/results or component controls inspected; not a universal causal proof

title: ThinkPrune: Pruning Long Chain-of-Thought of LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
method: 逐轮缩紧token上限做RL，超长且未完成的输出得零奖励。
reported_effect: R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B在AIME24推理长度减半，作者报告性能下降约2%。
mechanism_interpretation: 让模型学习跳过低效过程，而非让未适应短链的模型被迫中断。
conditions_and_limits: 结论针对特定模型/任务；需要多轮训练和完整性评价。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: Chain of Draft: Thinking Faster by Writing Less
method: 用极简但保留关键信息的草稿式中间表达替代冗长说明。
reported_effect: 在部分任务中以低至CoT 7.6%的token达到相当或更高准确率。
mechanism_interpretation: 压缩外显语言冗余，保留有用推导；不必减少所有语义计算。
conditions_and_limits: 7.6%是特定设置，不能当所有任务平均；极复杂推导可能损失必要细节。

mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

method: 估计题目所需token预算，把预算要求加入推理提示。

title: Training Large Language Models to Reason in a Continuous Latent Space
method: 把末层hidden state直接反馈为下一输入，用多阶段课程将显式步骤替换为连续thought。
reported_effect: ProsQA：97.0%对CoT 77.5%；GSM8K：34.1%低于CoT 42.9%；去掉课程后ProsQA降至76.1%。
mechanism_interpretation: 延缓离散单路径承诺，允许连续状态表示多个候选；课程是对齐接口的重要条件。
conditions_and_limits: 不是潜空间在所有任务都优越；其BFS解释有探针支持但不等于每一步精确枚举。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Selected original methods/results or component controls inspected; not a universal causal proof

title: Soft Thinking: Unlocking the Reasoning Potential of LLMs in Continuous Concept Space
method: 以词分布加权embedding形成连续概念token，并用Cold Stop处理低熵和潜式塌缩。
reported_effect: 数学/代码基准上最高提升pass@1 2.48个百分点，同时最高减少22.4% token。
mechanism_interpretation: 保持下一步分布信息，减少过早离散选择；停止模块同时缓解OOD连续输入。
conditions_and_limits: 两个最高值不必来自同一设置；相同文本词元数、latent步数和墙钟不是一个指标。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Selected original methods/results or component controls inspected; not a universal causal proof

title: Think before you speak: Training Language Models With Pause Tokens
method: 预训练和微调时加入可学习pause token，让输出前有额外计算。
reported_effect: 1B模型9项任务中8项提高；摘要报告SQuAD约18%、CommonsenseQA约8%、GSM8K约1%的指标增益。
mechanism_interpretation: 附加计算可以不承载自然语言推导，但模型必须学会利用它。
conditions_and_limits: 不是给任意现成模型插空白就有效；原实验要求预训练和微调均带pause。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking
method: 在普通文本每个位置生成解释未来文本的rationale，通过并行采样和训练学习内部思考。
reported_effect: 零样本GSM8K 5.9%到10.9%，CommonsenseQA 36.3%到47.2%。
mechanism_interpretation: 把思考学习从问答专用数据扩展到一般文本的难预测位置。
conditions_and_limits: 绝对性能仍有限，训练思考有成本；不是直接证明当代超长数学链质量。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
method: 区分无外部反馈的自我修订与依赖额外反馈的纠错，系统测试前者。
reported_effect: 在所测推理设置中常不能提升，部分模型在自纠错后反而下降。
mechanism_interpretation: 同一个错误信念重复检视不产生独立证据，还可能改坏正确答案。
conditions_and_limits: 研究对象是未专门学会有效纠错的模型；不能用标题否定SCoRe等训练后的能力。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: Reasoning Models Don't Always Say What They Think
method: 给正确/错误提示线索，检验模型是否在CoT中承认实际使用线索。
reported_effect: 6类提示实验中，使用线索时的显式承认率常低于20%；结果奖励RL也未使忠实度饱和。
mechanism_interpretation: 文本解释可能遗漏真正驱动答案的信息。
conditions_and_limits: 忠实度不是最终答案准确率；任务、模型、提示类型影响显著。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: The Illusion of Thinking: Understanding the Strengths and Limitations of Reasoning Models via the Lens of Problem Complexity
venue_description: NeurIPS 2025. camera-ready version + additional discussion in the appendix
method: 在可控复杂度的规划谜题中比较reasoning与non-reasoning模型及轨迹。
reported_effect: 观察到低复杂度非推理模型占优、中等复杂度长推理受益、高复杂度双方失败的分区。
mechanism_interpretation: 难度改变时，更多生成未必带来有效算法执行，甚至未用满预算就塌缩。
conditions_and_limits: 是受控谜题证据，不是证明所有LRM不具推理；输出格式、长度和解法要求是重要边界。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: Does Reinforcement Learning Really Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model?
method: 用pass@k、覆盖和似然分析区分采样效率与可解题覆盖。
reported_effect: 在所测设置中RLVR提高小k表现，但base在大k时可追上或超过；训练后覆盖可能缩窄。
mechanism_interpretation: 奖励重分配已有成功路径的概率，不必创造新解题策略。
conditions_and_limits: 有限pass@256不是数学上的能力上界；依赖模型、数据、解码和RL配方。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Selected original methods/results or component controls inspected; not a universal causal proof

title: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards Implicitly Incentivizes Correct Reasoning in Base LLMs
method: 研究仅有最终可验证奖励是否也能隐式偏好正确中间推理。
reported_effect: 给出理论和实验支持：终局奖励能够对中间推理形成隐式选择；不填单一跨任务提升率。
mechanism_interpretation: 中间过程与最终成功具有统计关联，终局奖励并非对过程完全无信息。
conditions_and_limits: 不等于每步都被正确监督，更不等于已证明超越base所有能力。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Authors rationale and survey interpretation; full mechanism not independently checked

title: The Expressive Power of Transformers with Chain of Thought

title: Math-Shepherd: Verify and Reinforce LLMs Step-by-step without Human Annotations
method: 用自动构造的步级监督训练PRM，再做重排和逐步PPO。
reported_effect: Mistral-7B：GSM8K 77.9%到84.1%，再验证达89.1%；MATH 28.6%到33.0%，再验证达43.5%。

title: ReST-MCTS*: LLM Self-Training via Process Reward Guided Tree Search
method: 由PRM指导树搜索，提取过程价值和成功轨迹，交替自训练策略与价值模型。

title: SpecReason: Fast and Accurate Inference-Time Compute via Speculative Reasoning
method: 小模型草拟简单步骤，大模型用单token效用评分接受或重做，并可叠加token级speculation。
reported_effect: 作者报告1.4–3.0倍实际推理加速及0.4–9.0%的准确率增益；叠加speculative decoding再减少8.8–58.0%延迟。
mechanism_interpretation: 只把易步骤交给小模型，验证仅短prefill；不要求思考逐token完全相同。
conditions_and_limits: 需要额外小模型和高接受率；原实现同卡轮流执行，并非已做内核并行。
effect_attribution: Authors reported; not independently reproduced in this survey
mechanism_evidence_scope: Selected original methods/results or component controls inspected; not a universal causal proof

title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Without Prompting
method: 从top-k备选token路径中寻找预训练模型已有的推理路径，而非只用贪心。

mechanism_interpretation: 生成分布内可能已有有用路径，触发/选择机制也是瓶颈。
conditions_and_limits: 探索替代路径有成本；不是所有长链行为都无需训练即可出现。

title: Graph of Thoughts: Solving Elaborate Problems with Large Language Models
method: 把thought组织为任意依赖图，支持合并、提炼和循环反馈。
reported_effect: 排序任务相对ToT质量提高62%、成本降低超过31%。
mechanism_interpretation: 可重用和聚合中间结果，避免把全部问题强制成一条链或互不相交的树。

title: Do LLMs Really Need 10+ Thoughts for "Find the Time 1000 Days Later"? Towards Structural Understanding of LLM Overthinking
method: 切分最小完整sub-thought、推断话语关系，构造细粒度思维推进图。
reported_effect: 简单任务上长思考模型慢5–20倍而无明显准确率收益；识别Explorer与Late Landing两种模式。
mechanism_interpretation: 冗余来源可区分为过度探索和过度验证，而不只是字数多。
conditions_and_limits: 话语标注图仍需独立校验，不能直接当成内部因果依赖。

title: Facts Don't Speak Louder than Words: The Behavioral Essence of Long-CoT Distillation
method: 分离事实正确性、题目多样性和推理行为；比较正/负轨迹及已会做的题，并研究损失随复杂度的变化。

method: 连续latent先探索，保留KV后切回显式CoT验证；可训练latent rollout/切换行为。
